beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Shanghai compresses schedule, factory-city, social image, cloud runway, buyer order, product identity and distributed memory into synchronized platform time. This chapter follows commerce: Between runway attention and an order sit identifiers, line sheets, showrooms, buyer permissions and product records whose adoption is often claimed faster than it is proved.
beats.onScreen: Then: China’s national standards portal records textile safety and apparel-use-information standards; these are product-governance records, not proof of a fashion-week passport system.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: China’s national standards portal records textile safety and apparel-use-information standards; these are product-governance records, not proof of a fashion-week passport system. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: CNIPA exposes a public trademark-search interface, but a query result must be saved and read before making any claim about a specific designer or mark.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: No reviewed official source establishes that every Shanghai runway garment carries a shared digital identity, traceability record or future product passport.
